title: Not worth the money
text: I started this for my son, who loves to cook and bake. I thought it would be great because everything is perfectly measured. Many of the kits take items I don't keep regularly stocked, so it became frustrating for him when he wanted to make something as soon as the box arrived.  It's actually been some time since I canceled the subscription and realized, I still have 3 kits around because he lost interest in it. You're better off getting a few kids cookbooks and planning things out that way. Less expensive that way.
label: neutral
